name: Gormak Stonewrought

abilities.name: Quarry-Face Regrowth
abilities.description: Whenever Gormak starts his turn with fewer than half his hit points, loose rubble knits itself back into Gormak's shoulders and ribs, restoring hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gormak makes two attacks: one with Stone Club and one with Boulder.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

Traits.name: Quarry-Face Regrowth
Traits.text: Whenever Gormak starts his turn with fewer than half his Hit Points, loose rubble knits itself back into Gormak's shoulders and ribs, restoring Hit Points.
Traits.clause: Gormak's hide is a quarry-face of old mountain stone, and wounds close by grinding shut rather than healing.

other_edition.lore: Cast out of its mountain clan for a crime no one speaks of, this giant wanders the lowlands alone, shunned by its own kind and unable to ask the small folk for anything but a fight.
